content: ORAVIG 50 mg buccal tablets are off-white in color and contain 50 mg of miconazole. Each tablet has one rounded side and one flat side. These tablets are available in bottles containing 14 tablets, identified by the National Drug Code (NDC) 43288-250-14. ORAVIG tablets should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20 to 25°C (68 to 77°F), with allowable short-term temperature variations between 15 and 30°C. The tablets must be protected from moisture and kept out of the reach of children.
